 Global Video Pros localizes video with AI: we translate the script, review it before release, generate a matching voice in each language, add lip-sync where the footage suits it, and version on-screen text and captions. Localization projects start at $2,500.

 THE SHORT ANSWER 
 How AI video localization works. 
 AI video localization turns a finished video into versions for other languages. The script is translated, a voice is generated for each language, either a matched version of the original speaker's voice with consent or a selected AI voice, and the audio is mixed back under the original music and effects. Where the presenter is on camera, AI lip-sync can adjust mouth movement so they appear to speak the new language. 
 Localization is more than audio. On-screen text, lower thirds, supers, captions, and end cards are versioned too, and some scenes or claims may need adapting for a market rather than translating word for word. 
 Compared with traditional dubbing or reshooting, AI localization is usually faster and costs less per language, which makes it practical to give every market the same launch film, training course, or executive message. Good candidates Product launch and brand films Training, onboarding, and compliance courses Executive and internal messages Explainers and product walkthroughs Paid-social ads entering new markets 
 
 
 WHAT WE LOCALIZE 
 Every layer of the video. 
 
 01 
 Script translation 
 Translation adapted for the screen, so lines fit the timing and sound natural when spoken. 
 
 
 
 02 
 Human review 
 Every translated script is reviewed before release, with your in-market team invited to approve. 
 
 
 
 03 
 Voice and dubbing 
 A consented voice match of the original speaker, or a selected AI voice, mixed under the original music. 
 
 
 
 04 
 Lip-sync 
 AI lip-sync for on-camera presenters where the shot size and footage quality suit it. 
 
 
 
 05 
 On-screen text 
 Lower thirds, supers, graphics, and end cards rebuilt in each language. 
 
 
 
 06 
 Captions and subtitles 
 Burned-in and sidecar caption files for every language version. 
 
 
 
 
 QUALITY & CONSENT 
 Reviewed by people, not just models. 
 Machine translation is fast but not always right, especially for product names, regulated claims, and tone. Every localized script is reviewed before release, and we ask your in-market colleagues to approve anything customer-facing. 
 Voice cloning uses a real person's voice, so we only do it with their written consent and an agreed scope of use. If consent is not possible, we use a selected AI voice instead.  WHERE TO START 
 Which videos to localize first. 
 Most teams have more video than budget to translate it. Start with the videos that do the most work in each market: the ones that sell, onboard, or train, and that will stay accurate for a while. Short, evergreen, presenter-led videos usually deliver the best return. 
 Leave fast-changing content, such as monthly updates or time-limited offers, until the workflow is proven, or plan it for an AI spokesperson so updates are cheap.
